Estonian

Noun

aluna

  1. essive singular of alg

Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Swedish alun, ultimately from Latin alumen.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈɑlunɑ/, [ˈɑ̝lunɑ̝]
  • Rhymes: -ɑlunɑ
  • Syllabification(key): a‧lu‧na
  • Hyphenation(key): alu‧na

Noun

[edit]
Finnish Wikipedia has an article on:
aluna
Wikipedia fi

aluna

  1. (chemistry) alum
